usage.callShape: POST https://x402.browserbase.com/browser/session/create with empty JSON body {} (no API key; x402 USDC on Base)
usage.outputShape: body.connectUrl (wss:// URL for Playwright/Puppeteer/CDP), body.sessionId, body.liveUrl (browser live-view), body.authToken, body.paidMinutes, body.expiresAt, body.pricing.amountPaid
quirks: Empty JSON body {} is sufficient — no required fields. inputSchema is null in the registry.
One paid POST = one prepaid browser session; default tier is 5 minutes for $0.01. Longer durations cost more ($0.03/15min, $0.06/30min, $0.12/hr) per the description — duration params not tested.

The real product is the returned connectUrl (a wss:// endpoint). You must then connect a Playwright/Puppeteer/CDP client to that URL to actually use the browser; the session expires at body.expiresAt.
Session is time-limited: body.paidMinutes=5 and body.expiresAt is ~5min out. Use it immediately.
qa-pay reported costUsd 0.002 but the response body shows the true charge: pricing.amountPaid=0.01 for paidMinutes=5.
usage.guide: POST to https://x402.browserbase.com/browser/session/create with an empty JSON body {} and pay the x402 quote (USDC on Base, ~$0.01 for a 5-minute session, no API key). The 200 response is JSON: read body.connectUrl — a wss:// URL you connect a Playwright/Puppeteer/CDP client to in order to drive a real cloud browser. body.liveUrl gives a human-watchable live view, and body.expiresAt tells you when the session dies (use it promptly). Each call buys a fresh single-use session; longer durations are available but were not tested here.
